rows.label: bf04240150_0010
rows.name: Then the one who attacked the soldiers...

rows.label: bf04240150_0020
rows.name:
wasn't the mechanical Blade standing there,
you say?

rows.label: bf04240150_0030
rows.name:
They look similar, but they're different, mo.
Nilny saw her clearly, mo.

rows.label: bf04240150_0040
rows.name:
I noticed we were being watched ever since
we arrived in this country, but...

rows.label: bf04240150_0050
rows.name: I'm sorry I made you uncomfortable, mo.

rows.label: bf04240150_0060
rows.name:
Nilny was secretly investigating
Avaritia Trading Company, mo.

rows.label: bf04240150_0070
rows.name:
Ah, so you watched us because we came here
on a Trading Company trading ship.

rows.label: bf04240150_0080
rows.name:
It's ironic that your surveillance
ended up proving our innocence.

rows.label: bf04240150_0090
rows.name:
...It seems this was my misunderstanding. I apologize
for the rudeness of suddenly starting a fight.

rows.label: bf04240150_0100
rows.name:
N-no, that's fine. Nobody got hurt in the end.
I'm just glad it all got cleared up now...

rows.label: bf04240150_0110
rows.name:
If Radiant Noble of Flame-dono lowers
her head, then little can be done.

rows.label: bf04240150_0120
rows.name:
Tora's still not satisfied, mo!
A year's supply of Sweet-Sweet Wieners will do, mo!

rows.label: bf04240150_0140
rows.name:
Hmm. I will do what I can within
my own means to compensate you.

rows.label: bf04240150_0150
rows.name:
By the way, the connection between you
and the culprit who fled...

rows.label: bf04240150_0160
rows.name: Could you tell me about it?
